steps.code:
# I have the access_token needed to call show_recommendations.
# I will now get all recommended songs by paging through results.
recommended_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    response = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=login_response["access_token"], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not response:
        break
    recommended_songs.extend(response)
    if len(response) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total recommended songs fetched: {len(recommended_songs)}")
